sent me e-mail on this topic and I'm afraid I lost it, so I can't

>>reply.  He/she said that you couldn't have both of these Hunting
>>Grounds out at the same time unless you had a Vampire that was both
>>Nosferatu and Bujah.  I don't see why this is so.  You could have 1
>>Nosferatu in play and 1 Brujah in play.  Then you could play the Slum
>>Hunting Ground on one turn and the Warzone Hunting Ground on the next.
>Unless WotC says otherwise, I completely agree with you. The clan
>restriction merely means that you need a member of that clan ready in
>order to use the master card.

Actually, you just need a member of the clan ready to play the Hunting
Ground.  Once it's in play, you can keep using it every turn even if
you have no ready vampires of the appropriate clan.  It was unclear from
your use of "use" which you meant, so I just thot I'd point that out.
